name: Sun City
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Sun City?
answer_short: Yes, if it is registered. In Sun City, the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office recommends golf carts stay on roads posted 35 mph or less. Bell Road, Grand Avenue and 99th Avenue are faster roads it calls unsafe for carts. Street-legal LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Bell Road?
faq.a: The Maricopa County Sheriff's Office lists Bell Road as a higher-speed road that is unsafe for golf carts; stay on roads posted 35 mph or less.

faq.q: Do golf carts in Sun City need to be registered?
faq.a: Yes. Golf carts on Sun City roads must be registered with the state, and the driver needs a valid driver's license.
